title: Mahjong-kyou Jidai Cebu Island '96
native_title: 麻雀狂時代セブアイランド’９６
overview:
Let's play on a southern island.

They're making it big in gravure, V-cinema and more! Chiasa Aonuma, Miho Nomoto and Kyoko Asagi - go head to head with these three queens on Cebu Island in the Philippines!! This summer, enjoy a happy, embarrassing mahjong date on a southern island.

南の島で遊びましょ。

グラビア・Vシネマ等で大活躍中！青沼ちあさ／野本美穂／麻木杏子3人のクィーンたちとフィリピン・セブ島で真剣勝負！！この夏は、南の島でうれし恥ずかし麻雀デート♡
